summary: Frontend-only verification of unified cross-location wall for guests (iteration_55). Confirmed FeedTab, ChatTab and backend /all endpoints deliver merged content from every location for a fresh guest (no ff_dj_profile, no ff_user_profile_id). LocationTag badges render for every post and message. Broadcast toggle stays DJ-only. Single-slug backend endpoint still returns scoped data. DMs picker path not reachable as plain guest by design (DMs tab is hidden when guestMode=true) — verified via source code that fetchLocationUsers hits /api/wall/users/all and header text is 'People across all locations:'.
critical_code_review_comments: SocialWallPage.jsx is 1523 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Should be split into per-tab modules (FeedTab, ChatTab, DMsTab, WhosHereTab, LiveTab) and a shared LocationTag/DJStatusBanner components file. Multi-tab file makes cross-location logic hard to audit.

fetchSlug is hard-coded to the string 'all' on lines 55 and 412 — this is fine for the requested config flip, but the variable name/pattern is misleading (it looks like it could vary with props). Consider dropping the variable and inlining `/wall/posts/all` for clarity, or making it explicit that this endpoint is always used regardless of the URL slug.

DMs tab is gated by !guestMode (line 1390). Because the request asked to verify DM picker as a guest, note that a plain guest can never reach the DMs tab in the UI — only logged-in non-DJ users can. The requirement should either allow guests to open DMs (remove !guestMode gate) or the test brief should be updated to specify a logged-in non-DJ user.

Location badge in LocationTag uses text-red-300 on bg-red-500/15 with a subtle border — contrast is acceptable on dark background but the 9px uppercase text is at the lower bound of legibility. Consider 10-11px for accessibility.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (POST-as-guest UI submit and DMs picker UI could not be executed by Playwright due to selector/timing flakiness; underlying code paths verified via source + prior iteration_54 pass)

test_credentials: None required. Guest flow uses fresh localStorage.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded posts (50 across 8 slugs) and chat messages (10 across 3 slugs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed and Chat tabs are the ones reachable by a plain guest — both correctly hit /wall/posts/all and /wall/chat/all, so LocationTag badges appear on every row. Broadcast toggle stays hidden. DMs tab is by design not shown to guestMode users; to test the DM picker path (data-testid new-dm-btn, 'People across all locations' header, /wall/users/all fetch) you need to set ff_user_profile_id to a real, existing user profile id — a bogus id triggers the invalid-profile fallback and reverts to guestMode. Backend verified: /wall/posts/all=50 posts / 8 slugs, /wall/chat/all=10/3, /wall/users/all=13/3, /wall/posts/edgewood-atlanta=11 posts (all edgewood-atlanta — single-slug scope preserved).
verified_flows: Guest opens /social/edgewood-atlanta with cleared localStorage — Feed tab shows 50 posts, LocationTag badges span 8 unique slugs (edgewood-atlanta, midtown-atlanta, stone-mountain, riverdale, douglasville, albany, valdosta, las-vegas).
broadcast-all-toggle NOT rendered for guest on Feed tab.
Chat tab shows messages tagged with locations OTHER than edgewood-atlanta (unique slugs: midtown, midtown-atlanta, edgewood-atlanta).
GET /api/wall/posts/edgewood-atlanta still returns only edgewood-atlanta posts (single-slug endpoint unchanged).
GET /api/wall/posts/all, /api/wall/chat/all, /api/wall/users/all all return merged cross-location data.
unverified_flows: Guest POSTing a new post via the UI send button — Playwright could not reliably click the paper-airplane submit button (React-controlled textarea did not accept programmatic .value set + input event in headless run). Code inspection shows POST path unchanged from iteration_54, where DJ POST end-to-end passed; guest path only differs by broadcast_all=false. Recommend main-agent self-verify by manually posting as a guest.
DMs picker with LocationTags — unreachable in guestMode; source code shows fetchLocationUsers uses /api/wall/users/all (line 555) and the header string 'People across all locations:' at line 620.
